title: Dousman House

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Make a positive impression, with your next town hall meeting, client appreciation event or company holiday party. Prairie du Chien's historic Dousman House, has every amenity and all the space your going to need to nearly every corporate event. With grace, elegance and a touch of class, we'll help make your wedding day, private party or corporate event perfect from start to finish With over a century and a half of history The Dousman House has seen it's share of the river life, come share in her history and add your memories to hers Take a look around. We have provided a 360 degree tour so you can view our entire facility
